title: Dimensional Film Rift
description: A woman in a red dress and 3D glasses leaps dramatically from a ruined, decaying room filled with old film reels, movie posters, and broken televisions, reaching toward a cinematic camera floating in mid-air. Through a massive jagged hole in the wall, a surreal alien landscape with a glowing green and pink sky is visible, where a lone figure in a yellow hazmat suit stands among wrecked cars.
